confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge, not checked against live listings. Restaurant and beer anchors are moderately reliable; hostel and hotel anchors are less certain because summer demand in Cardiff varies with events. GBP-to-USD conversion uses an assumed working rate of about 1.33, not a live rate. The FX observation came from a search result that described the RBA daily page; I did not open that page directly, so confirm 0.6955 on 2026-10-15 before relying on it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Basis is the UK regional city tier: Cardiff is a mid-sized Welsh capital with restaurant and bar prices below London and broadly similar to Bristol, Birmingham, and Nottingham, and with accommodation prices that rise in summer.
